live_pr18.title: Publish source-bound E13C5 OFF700 incoming and anchor pilot
live_pr18.body:
Publishes the recovered OFF700 three-segment incoming/anchor pilot and its existing scoped Astra review. The first toy failure, authorized toy-only repair source, raw results, checkpoint, and historical report/review are copied byte-for-byte from the verified recovery archive.

The publication is based on delivery commit `8fc3fb14dd33da10efa86c97c4beb9b0d12eeaad`. Source binding is `VERIFIED_GIT_PROJECTION_PLUS_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_BINDING`: all 139 projected archive files and all 303 archive manifest payload hashes verify; the exact 141-entry core contains two declared Git-only packaging sidecars. Nested archive dependencies are not claimed present in PR17. Replay uses the verified full recovery archive's original sibling layout.

Validation: immutable core/tree and manifest/lock identities match; task-only additive diff; 13 pilot files are byte-identical; diff check passes. No scientific replay, native run, gas evolution, six-control replay, full-path expansion, or merge. Existing PASS_SCOPED covers only the three fixed captured-path segments. Full-path, physical, production and receiver-adoption claims remain HOLD; recipient ACK remains separate.

Historical pending/publication-blocker statements are retained as recorded; the new source-binding sidecar supersedes their source materialization blocker only.
live_pr18.head: research/he-e13c5-off700-publication-20261011

live_pr19.title: Record reviewed E13C5 selected first2 branch cover
live_pr19.body:
The incoming-state and energy-anchor enclosure now covers 12 selected captured paths across OFF/KF/GM and four nodes, retaining all chronological carries and seams. The task contains 36 segments: three reviewed OFF700 records are reused and 33 are newly computed.

Independent Astra review approved PASS_SCOPED after checking source identities, 5490 finite ordered intervals, 144 zero-containing ledger intervals, carries, representation records and controls. One bounded execution exited 0 in 34.60 s; no solver rerun or core-code change occurred.

Scope is the finite enclosure of these selected paths with fixed gas interpolation, masks, source branches and energy anchors. Full first2, physical/production admission, new gas evolution, photon/heat/recoil and receiver adoption remain HOLD. This draft is stacked on PR18 and is not a merge request.
live_pr19.head: research/e13c5-first2-branch-cover-20261011
